Vermont’s Safest Teen Job Platform

Every feature in TeenWork was designed with one question: would a parent feel safe with this?

🔍

Verified Background Checks

Every employer on TeenWork completes identity verification before posting a single job. Parents can see verification status on every listing.

✅

Parental Approval System

No teen can accept a job without a parent’s explicit approval. Parents get notified instantly of every application, message, and job update.

🤖

AI Safety Screening

Every message between a teen and employer is scanned in real time for grooming language, personal info requests, and off-platform contact attempts.

🏘️

Safe Peer-to-Peer Gigs

All neighborhood gigs — lawn care, pet sitting, snow shoveling — are posted by verified local Vermont community members, not anonymous strangers.

⚖️

Vermont Labor Law Compliance

TeenWork automatically enforces Vermont child labor law hour limits by age. Work permits, hour caps, and restricted job types are flagged automatically.

How TeenWork Works in Vermont

From signup to first paycheck in minutes.

01

Teen + Parent sign up together

Parent verifies their identity at signup so teens can't create accounts without a guardian's knowledge.

02

AI matches teen to local jobs

Based on age, location, skills, and available transport — not just keyword search.

03

Parent approves the application

One tap from the parent dashboard. Parent gets an AI safety report on the employer before approving.

04

Teen works, earns ratings, builds future

Employers rate teens, write letters of recommendation, and the teen builds a real work history for college and beyond.

The Only Vermont Teen Job Platform Built With Safety at the Core

Every other job site is designed for adults. TeenWork is designed specifically for teens, their parents, and local employers — all three in one place.

🛡 Safety First

Parent co-signs every step

Parents verify their identity at signup, approve every job application, and control transport, messaging, and hours — all from their own dashboard.

🤖 AI-Powered

AI safety on every message

Every message between a teen and employer is scanned for grooming language, personal info requests, and off-platform contact attempts — in real time.

⚖️ Compliance

Labor law built in

Age restrictions, hour limits, and work permit requirements are surfaced automatically based on the teen's state — no guessing required.

📜 Career Builder

Letters of recommendation

Employers write verified letters of rec directly inside TeenWork. Teens download as PDF and use them for college, scholarships, and future jobs.

📍 Local

Real jobs near you

Structured listings with pay, age minimums, transport options, and distance estimates — not vague Craigslist posts.

🎓 Growth

Professional skills lessons

In-app courses on work ethic, conflict resolution, pay negotiation, and labor rights — written specifically for teen workers.

About TeenWork

Built by a teen. For every teen.

TeenWork started in Vermont when our 13-year-old founder, Aya, couldn't find a safe way to get her first job. Every adult job site she tried had no parent oversight, no safety checks, and no way for a teenager to actually get hired. So she built one — and won Hack America 2026.

Today TeenWork serves teens, parents, and employers in communities across all 50 states — with the same mission it started with: make it safe, simple, and empowering for teens to earn their first dollar.

⭐ Pro Plan

Everything in Pro — Free During Our Launch

TeenWork Pro is completely free right now while we're in early access. Pro gives teens every tool they need to land more jobs, earn more money, and build a real career foundation.

🤖

Unlimited AI Requests

Free users get limited daily AI calls. Pro members get unlimited — use the AI coach, job matching, and message helpers as much as you need.

📄

AI Resume Builder

Answer a few questions and get a polished, real resume you can download as a PDF — ready for jobs, college apps, and scholarship applications.

🧑‍🏫

AI Job Coach (Always On)

Ask the AI coach anything — how to negotiate pay, what to wear, how to handle a difficult employer. Real career advice written for teens.

✍️

Pitch AI for Applications

AI writes your intro message to employers for you — professional, personalized, and age-appropriate. Stand out from other applicants instantly.

🎯

Priority Job Matching

Pro members appear higher in employer search results and get notified of new jobs before free users — more visibility, more opportunities.

📬

Unlimited Applications

Free accounts can apply to up to 5 jobs at a time. Pro removes that limit so you can cast a wider net and maximize your chances of getting hired.

💬 Message Safety Filters

Child Protection

TeenWork automatically scans every message for bad language and predatory patterns. The first two filters are always on and can't be disabled — they protect your teen.

✓
🚫 Profanity Filter
Blocks swear words and inappropriate language
Always ON
✓
🛡️ Safety Pattern Filter
Blocks grooming language, requests to meet alone, and predatory patterns
Always ON
✓
👀 Parent Can Read Chats
Review all messages anytime in the Messages tab
Always ON
⚠️ What triggers an automatic block?
  • Profanity and sexual language
  • Asking a teen to meet alone or in private
  • Requests for photos or personal information
  • "Keep this secret" / "Don't tell your parents" type phrases
  • Offers to pick up the teen or invitations to a private home alone
  • Requests to communicate off-platform (Snapchat, WhatsApp, etc.)

All blocked messages are logged. Repeated violations are reported to the platform safety team.

📄 Terms of Use & Privacy

Last updated: April 2025 · Version 2.0

1. Who Can Use TeenWork

TeenWork is a supervised teen employment platform for teens ages 13–17, their parents/guardians (18+), and employers posting legal age-appropriate jobs. By creating an account you confirm you meet the eligibility requirements for your account type and that all information you provide is accurate and truthful.

2. Parent & Guardian Accounts

Parent accounts must be created by an adult (18+). Creating a parent account as a minor to bypass oversight violates these terms and may result in permanent suspension. We use date-of-birth verification and knowledge questions to enforce this. Parents bear ultimate responsibility for their teen's job activity on this platform.

3. Teen Worker Accounts

Teen accounts require a linked parent/guardian. Parents retain full oversight and approval authority over all job applications, messaging, and profile activity. Teens may not disable or circumvent parental controls. TeenWork may share relevant activity summaries with linked parent accounts at any time.

4. Employer Responsibilities

Employers must comply with all applicable federal and state child labor laws. Specifically:

  • All job postings must accurately describe duties, pay, and time requirements.
  • Employers may not require teens under 16 to operate heavy machinery, work past 10pm on school nights, or exceed legal hour limits.
  • Employers must obtain and retain any required work permits or employment certificates.
  • Misrepresentation of job duties, pay, or working conditions is grounds for immediate account termination.
  • Employers may not request any information from teens that is not strictly related to job performance.

5. Safety & Child Protection

TeenWork automatically scans all messages for inappropriate, harmful, or predatory content. Blocked messages are logged and may be reviewed by our safety team. Patterns of concerning behavior are reported to the appropriate authorities. We maintain zero tolerance for grooming, harassment, or exploitation of minors.

6. Data Collection & Privacy

We collect name, email, age, location (city/state), skills, and job activity data necessary to operate the platform. We do not sell personal data. We share only what is required for job matching: for teens, employers see first name, age, city, and skills only — never contact info, photos, or full legal name until a job is parent-approved. Parent contact info is never shared with employers.

7. Push & Email Notifications

By creating an account you agree to receive transactional emails (account verification, job updates, safety alerts). You may optionally enable push notifications for new job matches, application status updates, and platform activity. You can adjust notification preferences at any time in your account settings. If you are inactive for 7+ days, we may send you a re-engagement email to let you know about new jobs or activity in your area. You can opt out of these emails at any time.

8. AI Features

TeenWork uses AI to assist with job matching, message safety screening, and informational responses. AI responses are informational only and do not constitute legal, financial, or professional advice. AI language checks are used to review message content for safety — this is a mandatory feature that cannot be disabled for accounts involving minors.

9. Location Data

We use your city and state to match you with nearby jobs. We do not collect GPS or precise location data. You may update your location at any time in your profile. Location data is used only for job matching and is never shared with third parties for advertising.

10. Account Activity & Re-engagement

If your account has been inactive for 7 or more days, TeenWork may send you an in-app message and/or email to notify you of new opportunities, nearby job activity, or platform updates relevant to your profile. These messages are sent to help you not miss opportunities — not for advertising purposes. You can opt out in settings.

11. Termination

We may suspend or terminate accounts that violate these terms, misrepresent user identity, put minors at risk, or are reported for repeated safety violations. Terminated accounts may be reviewed if there is evidence of an error.

12. Contact & Support

Questions or concerns? Email ayaquarrierdraper@gmail.com or use the in-app report button on any AI response.

Common questions

Can I try Pro before paying?

Yes — while TeenWork is in early access, all Pro features are available for free. You'll be notified before any billing starts.

What counts as an "AI request"?

Each time the AI writes or suggests something — resume bullet, cover letter, coaching tip — counts as one request. Free and Pro accounts share the same AI service (Groq), but use separate API quotas so Pro usage never limits Free users and vice versa. During testing, both plans get generous access.

Is it really free for teens and parents?

The Free plan is free forever. Pro unlocks more AI and advanced features. We never take a cut of what teens earn.
